material.description:
scenarios/moba/slot-models.tsv:32,39-42 (neutral_fel_beast, giant_wolf, alpha_wolf, wildkin, enraged_wildkin -> character-zombie 'as stand-in'); lines 30-31,34-38 map kobold/centaur/furbolg/golem/ogre to character-skeleton/orc. assets.json:1217 ships neutral-fel-beast-skinned.glb and ~40 neutral-*-skinned.glb.
Acceptance: Each neutral slot names its own neutral-*-skinned model, or documents (marked UNVERIFIED) why not; creeps still on generic builds (creep_ranged archer, siege orc, super/mega zombie/ghost/vampire, courier human, wards candle, rune coin) get an hy3d model request row each.
Witness route: Neutral spawns draw their own skinned model in the offline sim render; slot-models rows contain no 'stand-in'.
